title: How Your Phone Knows Which Way Is Up 📱 #shorts
description:
Turn your phone sideways and the screen follows. Inside is an accelerometer: a tiny silicon weight on springs that gravity tugs toward the ground. Here's how it turns that tiny shift into 'down', why it reads zero when your phone is falling, and how laptops used that to save their hard drives.

Follow Hidden Mechanics for more everyday engineering, explained in under a minute.
